name: Full Vehicle Wraps
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey wraps cars, vans, trucks and SUVs on all sides — often the roof too — in color-matched 3M vinyl.
long: Applied Graphics wraps full vehicles at its 6,000-square-foot shop in Kenilworth, New Jersey, covering all four sides and often the roof in printed, color-matched 3M vinyl. The company has done this since 1978, and every installer is 3M-certified, so the finished wrap qualifies for the 3M MCS warranty. Design is handled in-house, concept to completion, on anything from one custom vehicle to a fleet of 500.

name: Fleet Graphics
short: Applied Graphics builds color-consistent fleet graphics out of Kenilworth, New Jersey — two vans or two hundred, matched now and on re-orders years later.
long: Fleet graphics from Applied Graphics keep every vehicle in an operation identical, and the Kenilworth, New Jersey shop has been producing them since 1978. Templates and color matching stay on file, so a van added three years from now still matches the first one. The 6,000-square-foot facility takes vehicles up to 53 feet long, and 3M-certified installers travel on-site for rollouts too large to bring in.

name: Partial Wraps, Vinyl & Lettering
short: Partial wraps, cut vinyl lettering and decals from Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey — brand presence on a vehicle without covering every panel.
long: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey cuts and installs partial wraps, spot graphics, decals and vinyl lettering for owners who don't need all four sides covered. The same in-house art department and 3M-certified installers handle a door logo, a phone number or a full side panel. It is the practical option for a clean vehicle that only needs to say who you are and how to reach you.

name: Color-Change Wraps
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey changes a vehicle's color with 3M gloss, matte, satin or metallic film laid over the factory paint, not instead of it.
long: Applied Graphics changes vehicle color at its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop, applying 3M film in gloss, matte, satin or metallic over the factory paint instead of repainting it. All installers are 3M-certified and the work carries the 3M MCS warranty. Vinyl removal is a service the shop performs as well, so the film comes off and the original paint is still underneath when the owner wants it back.

name: Food Truck Wraps
short: Applied Graphics designs and installs food truck, trailer and cart wraps in Kenilworth, New Jersey, with designers carrying over 20 combined years of wrap work.
long: Applied Graphics wraps food trucks, trailers and carts at its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop, where the food-truck designers have over 20 combined years of vehicle-wrap experience between them. The graphics go on in 3M vinyl, since a truck's exterior has to survive heat, grease and daily washing. Installation is done by 3M-certified crews and the finished wrap carries the 3M MCS warranty.

name: Race Car & Performance Graphics
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey builds sponsor liveries, numbering and track lettering for race and performance cars, installed by 3M-certified crews.
long: Applied Graphics produces race car liveries, numbers, track lettering and sponsor decals from Kenilworth, New Jersey, 27 minutes from Manhattan. Everything is installed by 3M-certified crews in a 6,000-square-foot heated and cooled shop. One customer wrapped a track-prepped Roush Stage 3 here and reported in 2018 that the graphics held up through a full season of track events.

name: Trains, Buses & Box Trucks
short: Applied Graphics wraps box trucks, trailers, buses and rail cars in Kenilworth, New Jersey, in a shop that takes vehicles up to 14 feet high and 53 feet long.
long: Applied Graphics handles the largest vehicles inside its 6,000-square-foot facility in Kenilworth, New Jersey, which takes units up to 14 feet high and 53 feet long — box trucks, trailers, buses and rail cars included. Prints run up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long, so color stays consistent across a whole flank. When a vehicle cannot come to Kenilworth, the installers go to it.

name: Interior & Exterior Building Graphics
short: Applied Graphics produces wall murals, lobby branding, dimensional letters and exterior building signage in Kenilworth, New Jersey, measured and installed on-site.
long: Applied Graphics brands buildings inside and out from Kenilworth, New Jersey: wall murals, lobby and office environmental graphics, dimensional letters and logos, storefronts and exterior building signage. Printing runs up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long, and installation happens at your location after a site survey, so large walls are measured before anything is produced. The company has worked this way since 1978.

name: Architectural Finishes & 3M DI-NOC
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey installs 3M DI-NOC architectural film — over 500 surfaces in wood, metal and stone looks — over existing walls and doors.
long: Applied Graphics installs and replaces 3M DI-NOC architectural finishes from Kenilworth, New Jersey, resurfacing doors, walls, elevators, columns and fixtures without tearing them out. There are over 500 DI-NOC surfaces to choose from, including wood, metal, stone and solid color. The work is done by the same 3M-certified crew that handles the vehicle wraps, on interiors, storefront windows and exteriors alike.

name: Window Graphics & Perforation
short: Applied Graphics in Kenilworth, New Jersey applies perforated one-way film, frosted graphics and cut vinyl to storefront windows without blocking the view out.
long: Applied Graphics turns storefront glass into signage from its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop, using cut vinyl, frosted and opaque films, and one-way perforated window graphics that advertise outward while people inside still see through. Retail, restaurant and office storefronts are the usual jobs. Prints run up to 60 inches wide, and the 3M-certified crew installs on-site across New Jersey, New York and Philadelphia.

name: Banners, Signs & Magnets
short: Applied Graphics prints banners, building signage, vehicle magnets and large-format graphics up to 60 inches wide by 150 feet long in Kenilworth, New Jersey.
long: Applied Graphics prints banners, building and wall signage, vehicle magnets and large-format graphics up to 60 inches wide and 150 feet long at its Kenilworth, New Jersey shop. The company says it produced graphics for World Cup activity at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, during the 2026 tournament. Printing is in-house and installation is done by its own 3M-certified crew.

name: In-House Design & Installation
short: Applied Graphics keeps design, printing and 3M-certified installation in one 6,000-square-foot building in Kenilworth, New Jersey, and installs on-site as well.
long: Applied Graphics runs a full in-house art department and a 3M-certified installation crew at 718 B Jefferson Ave in Kenilworth, New Jersey, taking a project from concept to completion in one building. The shop is 6,000 square feet, heated and cooled. Crews also install on the road at your location, and site surveys are done before large jobs so the measurements are right the first time. In business since 1978.
